farms.people: Bernhard and Peta Veller; land purchased 1990, first vines 1992.

farms.history: 312-year winemaking history (1698) — one of the oldest continuously used cellars in South Africa (the 300-year-old barrel room still in service); Parker family stewardship since 1852, six generations.
farms.people: Parker family since 1852 (George Francis Parker, arrived at the Cape 1819 with family later settling in Australia).

farms.history: Wine and olive estate on the M13; vineyards 240-400m on the Tygerberg (SB at the summit).

farms.history: Hooggelegen Farm, Vissershok Road — De Wit family for five-plus generations, among the oldest family farms in the valley; M.J. de Wit began making wine as a hobby in 2006, and with wife Estani took over farm management in 2010.

farms.name: Canto Boutique Wines
farms.hours: Tastings Tue-Sat; picnics Sat-Sun & public holidays first-come first-served; pizza Fri-Sun.
farms.history: Cap Classique specialist — signature MCC-and-macaron pairing, plus a non-alcoholic macaron/artisan-tonic pairing; old low-yielding dryland vines feed the wooded Chardonnay, Merlot and MCCs. Chapel-like Cape Dutch tasting room.
